entries.04243aeeacf35ad8: Headquartered in Nakagawa-ku, Nagoya, the company forms a group with 1 consolidated subsidiary. Consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 numbered 439.
entries.07c9b6eccce6a0dc: The company provides housing equipment work such as hot-water floor heating and solar power system installation, renovation and waterproofing work, housing-related services such as termite prevention and extermination, and building cleaning and janitorial management services.
entries.1a8b4b22cf279898: As its medium-term management strategy, the company shows a policy of continuing its business for newly built houses while further focusing on businesses for existing houses and existing structures, in which it has strengths. In the construction business, it is working to win comprehensive repair work on building exteriors and to strengthen its capacity to handle large structures, and in cooperation with the building maintenance business, to link exterior wall inspections to proposals and orders for repair work. It also states that the real estate business will expand into land sales and the purchase and renovation of used houses and condominiums. It states that it will strengthen recruitment and employee training, work to secure stable orders from major homebuilders and major building maintenance companies, and develop sales channels, including direct orders.
entries.1f3b3dea46abaef4: Since its founding in 1973, the company has consistently maintained within the group businesses related to the upkeep of structures, ranging from housing equipment work to renovation, waterproofing, housing-related services such as termite control, and building maintenance. Through cooperation between the construction business and the building maintenance business, it has a structure that can handle everything from exterior wall inspection to proposing and receiving repair work orders, and it operates a network of sales offices centered on the Tokai region.
entries.26ba029474010e3f: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥11,088 million, up 7.4% from the previous consolidated fiscal year. The breakdown was ¥7,736 million for the construction business, ¥1,995 million for the building maintenance business and ¥1,356 million for the housing-related services business.
